Definition: from G1 (as a negative particle) and G3741; wicked:--unholy.
BiblicalUsage: Paul lists the unholy among those for whom the law is made, and warns that in the last days men will be unholy, without natural affection, trucebreakers. The word names the man with no reverence left in him.
TheologicalSignificance: A word for the unholy carries no teaching of its own; its darkness is Paul's, that a heart without reverence ends among the marks of the last days.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
